description: Registry of Open Data on AWS (urban, water, hazard and energy tags) is a registry of open datasets listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS (urban, water, hazard and energy tags), a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3, published or maintained by Amazon Web Services Open Data Sponsorship Program. It is a searchable index of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3, with a description, licence, update frequency and access route for each; the datasets tagged urban, water, floods, earthquakes and electricity include building stock and load profiles, flood mapping, storm surge forecasts, seismic networks and wind resource data. Coverage: worldwide, dataset by dataset. Most datasets under the water and hydrology tags are weather, ocean and land-surface products and were left out; the audit file names each. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset; the registry page of each dataset states the terms. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding cloud-hosted open data for infrastructure analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws-urban-water-hazard-tags.
